summary.plain: Two identical liquid-helium-filled cells in a strong electric field, where neutrons are cooled to ultracold energies, stored, and watched through flashes of light for a tiny change in how their spins turn.
summary.technical: Two measurement cells with opposite electric fields (75 kV/cm, Cavallo multiplier, 630 kV) in liquid 4He at 0.5 K; polarized 3He co-magnetometer; multilayer magnetic shield enclosure; magnet tested at Caltech and moved to ORNL.

technology.quote: The experiment has two identical measurement cells with the electric field in opposite directions to control systematics.
technology.value: Superfluid-helium ultracold-neutron production and storage in two measurement cells with polarized He-3 co-magnetometry and a 75 kV/cm electric field
